title: Diversity and Language Technology: How Techno-Linguistic Bias Can Cause Epistemic Injustice

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of lexical gaps in multilingual databases (e.g., WordNet) and case studies of machine translation errors (e.g., DeepL, Google Translate) regarding culturally specific concepts (kinship terms, food varieties) in languages like Swahili, Japanese, Hungarian, Mongolian, and Korean compared to English.

Analysis of machine translation errors when using English as a pivot language between gendered languages (French to Italian), specifically observing the loss of gender information for terms like "cousin".
